description: One thing that happened on the hub (contract `devagotchi.signal/v1`).

actor.description: Who did it: an account, an agent seat (`<account>/<seat>`), or `hub`.

at_ms.description: When, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

data.description:
The rest, only to a sink that takes `full`: a board event's data, a tenant event's
detail, a tool call's `via`.

id.description:
Stable and unique: `board:<tenant>:<board>:<seq>:<hash>`, `tenancy:<tenant>:<seq>:<hash>`
or `audit:<seq>:<hash>` (the hash's first 16 hex digits). Sent again, it is the same.

kind.description:
What happened: a board action (`ticket.claimed`, `approval.decided` …), a tenant
event (`org.member_set` …), or `tool.<name>` for a tool call.

operation.description: The operation a tool call named.

outcome.description: How a tool call ended: `ok`, or the refusal's code (`read_only`, `not_granted` …).

owner.description:
Whose board: an account, `org-<tenant>` for an organisation, `@shared` for a
configured board.

target.description: What a tool call was aimed at: a broker or a board's project name.

tenant.description: The tenant it happened in (`t-<uuid>`); absent for the hub's audit chain.

title: Signal
